schema:
CREATE TABLE customer (
  c_acctbal,
  c_address,
  c_comment,
  c_custkey,
  c_mktsegment,
  c_name,
  c_nationkey,
  c_phone
);

CREATE TABLE lineitem (
  l_comment,
  l_commitdate,
  l_discount,
  l_extendedprice,
  l_linenumber,
  l_linestatus,
  l_orderkey,
  l_partkey,
  l_quantity,
  l_receiptdate,
  l_returnflag,
  l_shipdate,
  l_shipinstruct,
  l_shipmode,
  l_suppkey,
  l_tax
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
  o_clerk,
  o_comment,
  o_custkey,
  o_orderdate,
  o_orderkey,
  o_orderpriority,
  o_orderstatus,
  o_shippriority,
  o_totalprice
);

CREATE TABLE part (
  p_brand,
  p_comment,
  p_container,
  p_mfgr,
  p_name,
  p_partkey,
  p_retailprice,
  p_size,
  p_type
);

CREATE TABLE partsupp (
  ps_availqty,
  ps_comment,
  ps_partkey,
  ps_suppkey,
  ps_supplycost
);

CREATE TABLE supplier (
  s_acctbal,
  s_address,
  s_comment,
  s_name,
  s_nationkey,
  s_phone,
  s_suppkey
);
